claims.text: Many reviewers describe the hair as soft, with several also noting little to no tangling or shedding.
Some reviewers report negative experiences including dryness, brittleness, shedding, or burning when heat-styled.
Several reviewers praise the hair's quality and value, saying they are happy with the purchase and would order again.
A few reviewers complain about thinness or incorrect/incomplete orders.
Some reviewers note the hair does not hold its curl or original wave after washing.
